en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large neoclassical building with many windows and balconies, identified as the prefecture palace. In front of it there is a crowded public scene with soldiers in formation, carriages, early automobiles, and a large gathering of people. A church steeple is visible in the background. Greek text appears above the image, and French text describing the palace is printed on the right.
